variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { service }
| fields service

timeseries avg(aerospike_xdr_lap_us, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { dc }
| fields dc

0.content: **XDR View**: Per destination: lag, throughput, retries, errors. Open it when lag grows or a site falls behind. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.title: XDR Statistics Summary
2.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_xdr_throughput, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }, rollup: avg), a1 = avg(aerospike_xdr_lag, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }), a2 = avg(aerospike_xdr_latency_ms, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }), a3 = avg(aerospike_xdr_lap_us, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }), a4 = sum(aerospike_xdr_recoveries_pending, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }, rollup: avg), a5 = sum(aerospike_xdr_in_progress, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }, rollup: avg), a6 = sum(aerospike_xdr_in_queue, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }, rollup: avg), a7 = sum(aerospike_xdr_bytes_shipped, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }, rate: 1s)
| fieldsAdd total_throughput = a0[], avg_lag = a1[], avg_ship_latency = a2[], avg_lap_us = a3[], total_recoveries_pending = a4[], total_in_progress = a5[], total_in_queue = a6[], total_bytes_shipped = a7[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
| fields total_throughput = coalesce(total_throughput[-2], arrayLast(total_throughput)), avg_lag = coalesce(avg_lag[-2], arrayLast(avg_lag)), avg_ship_latency = coalesce(avg_ship_latency[-2], arrayLast(avg_ship_latency)), avg_lap_us = coalesce(avg_lap_us[-2], arrayLast(avg_lap_us)), total_recoveries_pending = coalesce(total_recoveries_pending[-2], arrayLast(total_recoveries_pending)), total_in_progress = coalesce(total_in_progress[-2], arrayLast(total_in_progress)), total_in_queue = coalesce(total_in_queue[-2], arrayLast(total_in_queue)), total_bytes_shipped = coalesce(total_bytes_shipped[-2], arrayLast(total_bytes_shipped))
2.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_xdr_throughput{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"})
avg(aerospike_xdr_lag{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"})
avg(aerospike_xdr_latency_ms{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"})
avg(aerospike_xdr_lap_us{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"})
sum(aerospike_xdr_recoveries_pending{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"})
sum(aerospike_xdr_in_progress{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"})
sum(aerospike_xdr_in_queue{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"})
sum(rate(aerospike_xdr_bytes_shipped{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", dc=~"$dc|$^"}[1m]))

3.title: DC Nodes
3.query:
timeseries value = avg(aerospike_xdr_nodes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(dc, array($dc)) }), by: { dc }
| fields dc, value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
3.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
avg(aerospike_xdr_nodes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", dc=~"$dc"}) by (dc)

4.title: Host TCP Connections (total)
4.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_sysinfo_netstat_tcp_activeopens, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }, rollup: avg)
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
4.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum (aerospike_sysinfo_netstat_tcp_activeopens{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^"})
sum (aerospike_sysinfo_netstat_tcp_currestab{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^"})

5.title: Host Network Traffic - retransmit (packets) (total) (rate)
5.query:
timeseries a0 = avg(aerospike_sysinfo_netstat_tcp_retranssegs, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { cluster_name, service }
| fieldsAdd a0 = arrayDelta(a0)
| fieldsAdd a0 = a0[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd value = a0[]
| fieldsRemove a0
| summarize value = sum(value[]), by: { timeframe, interval }
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
5.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum (irate(aerospike_sysinfo_netstat_tcp_retranssegs{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^"}[$__rate_interval] ))

6.title: Host Network Traffic (bytes) (total) (rate)
6.query:
timeseries a0 = avg(aerospike_sysinfo_network_receive_bytes_total, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { cluster_name, service }
| fieldsAdd a0 = arrayDelta(a0)
| fieldsAdd a0 = a0[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd value = a0[]
| fieldsRemove a0
| summarize value = sum(value[]), by: { timeframe, interval }
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
6.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum (irate(aerospike_sysinfo_network_receive_bytes_total{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", }[$__rate_interval]))
sum (irate(aerospike_sysinfo_network_transfer_bytes_total{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", }[$__rate_interval]))
